lines.t: The heart of a child is meek and mild,
They come running to the Lord when He calls.
God’s precious sheep, each one He will keep,
Hidden away in His fold.
And the Lord will protect all those who are His,
No danger will harm them at all.
Little fireflies who light up the sky,
He guides them to know where to go.
By His loving hand He gives His command,
And His fireflies put on a show.
They sing to the Lord in one accord,
And beautiful music begins to grow.
His praises resound in the sky,
These little ones sing to their beloved King:
Praise Yahushua, our Adonai.
They’re like little flowers; He waters them well,
And smiles at them all with delight.
And smiles at them all with delight.
For a moment they’re ours, these precious flowers,
So, mothers, please raise them just right.
They’re here with us today,
Though they could be gone tomorrow.
Parents, don’t cry—they’re all right.
